# Rork

> > Rork is a no-code mobile app platform that enables users to build iOS and Android apps using plain language programming, with support for React Native, Expo Go, and third-party API integrations.

Rork provides a complete mobile app development solution with multiple tiers (Rork Pro, Rork Max) and companion tools. The platform simplifies app creation, testing with Rork Companion, and publishing to the App Store and Google Play without traditional coding.

## Key Topics

- No-code platform
- Mobile app development
- Plain language programming
- React Native
- Expo Go
- App Store publishing
- Android app building
- Rork Pro
- Rork Max
- Rork Companion
- Third-party API integration
- Google Maps API
- Xcode
- Swift
- Mobile app builder
